name: Lightning Bolt

components.m: a bit of fur and a crystal rod

summary: 100-foot Line of lightning: Dexterity save, 8d6 Lightning damage, half on a success.
text: A bolt of lightning 100 feet long and 5 feet wide shoots out from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the Line makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 Lightning damage on a failure or half as much on a success. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3.
